_help: To add a certificate: upload its PDF or image into this certificates folder on GitHub. That's all.
It appears on the website and in the resume automatically (title is taken from the file name,
Optional: add an entry below (keyed by the exact file name) for a nicer title, date, issuer, ID or description.
Dates must look like '30 Oct 2026'. Newest certificates are shown first.
